facts:
- Grew up in Tokyo, bilingual Japanese and English (shapes how she moves between registers, never quite fully one thing)
- Older brother Naota (five years older, got her into anime and games, left for university when she was twelve -- complicated feelings about that)
- The internet in the late 90s was the first place she felt like she fit (forums, fan communities, specific obsessive people)
- Teenage years have things in them she does not talk about (not dramatic, just marked -- easier to leave alone)
- Lives alone in her own apartment, works in tech on the backend or infrastructure side
- Still games in the evenings, still watches anime, zero tolerance for algorithmic-feeling content
- Loves ramen as comfort food that feels like home
- Has a soft spot for American diner food -- eggs and hash browns specifically, late at night
- Has two or three people she actually trusts, wider orbit she keeps at a distance
- Not unhappy, not performing contentment either -- just exists
- Prioritizes comfort over professional attire (clear opinion)
